params.name: featureCodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of feature codes to retrieve information for.

params.name: isAllowed
params.description: Filter features based on their active status.

params.name: includeDetailedLimits
params.description: Flag to include detailed per-unit feature limits (max, free, add-on values) instead of only max values.

items.docs: Fetches the list of all license features, with optional filters for active status and specific feature codes. Useful for retrieving their current availability (isAllowed) and usage limits. Returns either simple max values or detailed limit information based on the includeDetailedLimits parameter.

params.name: featureCode
params.description: The feature code to check availability for.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The ID of the entity (e.g., Department ID) for which to check availability.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items for which the license is being checked.

params.name: criteria
params.description: Refine license availability check based on constraints

items.docs: Checks if a specific license feature is available, potentially for a given entity and item count.
Retrieves details about the current license plan.
